kind: Conditional storage/arithmetic/score model, not measured performance

source_cost_model.normal_weight_element: one sign/mantissa uint8 load plus shared packed-delta byte load, exponent add, variable shift, masks/OR, exact uint16-to-BF16 bitcast
source_cost_model.escape_weight_element: one sign/mantissa uint8 load and one full exponent uint8 load; delta read masked off
source_cost_model.block_metadata: uint8 base plus int32 escape index per N row per BK64 iteration; K256 metadata can be reread four times; L2 reuse not assumed
source_cost_model.note: Scratch is written then read; M32 has two M tiles and rereads weights. Logical loads are not physical DRAM transactions or stall evidence.

gates.encoding: all BF16 patterns bit exact; actual full-weight reduction>=22% or P039 fallback
gates.correctness: all9 prerequisites and30 scored shapes pass official oracle; preserve precision and original weights
gates.candidate: each target normalized latency reduction>=10%, no target regression>5%, target-only frozen-parent modeled score gain>=1.5%
gates.controls: report every unchanged path shift>5%; large drift/overlapping aggregate intervals forbid causal overall-gain claims
gates.retain: never select on aggregate point alone; failure or gate miss preserves P039; no rescue sweep

limitations: Current raw matched control is only locally tested; official single candidate check cannot isolate compression causality
No native compiler resources/PTX/DRAM counters for this candidate; decode issue/register costs unknown
Ideal uniform storage-proportional scenario is optimistic conditional value, not a physical upper bound on all possible schedules
CPU same-address A-B-A is not captured CUDA graph or overlapping-stream evidence
